text: Assumption: The instance of StartAsynchronousExecutionResponse is released by the Diagnostic Management after creation and transmission of the SOVD response to the client — is this correct?

assumption: The instance of StartAsynchronousExecutionResponse is released by the Diagnostic Management after creation and transmission of the SOVD response to the client.
rationale: The SWS payload specifies the transfer via Future and Variant, but contains no statement about the internal destruction time in the stack.
